name: Timesheet Custom Report
query:
SELECT
    ts.name AS "Timesheet:Link/Timesheet:150",
    ts.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:150",
    ts.employee_name AS "Employee Name:180",
    tl.task AS "Task:Link/Task:150",
    p.project_name As "Project",
    t.subject AS "Task Subject:Data:200",
    t.description AS "Task Description",
    t.status AS "Task Status:Data:120",
    tl.activity_type AS "Activity Type:150",
    tl.from_time AS "From Time:Datetime:160",
    tl.to_time AS "To Time:Datetime:160",
    tl.hours AS "Hours:Float:100",
    t.custom_assigned_by AS "Assigned By:Data:150",
    t.custom_assigned_start_date_ AS "Assigned Start Date:Datetime:180"
FROM
    `tabTimesheet` ts
INNER JOIN
    `tabTimesheet Detail` tl
    ON tl.parent = ts.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabTask` t
    ON t.name = tl.task
LEFT JOIN
    `tabProject` p
    ON p.name = t.project
WHERE
    ts.docstatus < 2
    AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR ts.employee = %(employee)s)
    AND (%(from_time)s IS NULL OR %(from_time)s = '' OR tl.from_time >= %(from_time)s)
    AND (%(to_time)s IS NULL OR %(to_time)s = '' OR tl.to_time <= %(to_time)s)
ORDER BY
    ts.start_date DESC,
    ts.name DESC;
